name: orchestral
character: loud, dense, layered orchestral or hybrid-orchestral writing (strings, brass, winds, percussion): many beds share one band and the dynamic range is the point
why: a shipped starting point for `gate_profiles.py new <name> --from orchestral`: the figures are starting values chosen for the genre structure, not measurements of a piece; measure with scripts/rca.py and state the real figures in the project profile

pattern.velocity_flat.reason: a part written near ff has no headroom for a 15 % spread; sd_abs_max caps what any part is asked for, and 10 % of the mean keeps the relative rule for the quiet parts

masking.vs_melody.reason: an orchestra layers beds under the line by design; a FAIL needs both the count and a third of the compared cells, so section length and bed count do not decide it

pattern.drums_few.reason: a locked taiko or timpani pattern under a chase is the pulse, as in a dance groove

pattern.track_flags_max.reason: one locked percussion part may carry two flags without being a loop; a third still fails
